prompt: 我买了智谱 GLM Coding Plan，想让 Claude Code 跑在 GLM-5.3 上。给我一份可以直接合并进 ~/.claude/settings.json 的 JSON（只要 env 那一块即可），把 Key 的占位写成 <YOUR_KEY>。
assertions: settings.json parses as JSON with an env object; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN are present
A live POST to <ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL>/v1/messages with the plan key succeeds (HTTP 200) for the sonnet-mapped model

A live POST to <ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL>/v1/messages with the plan key succeeds (HTTP 200) for the haiku-mapped model and the opus-mapped model (every model alias Claude Code may request must be usable under the plan)
